name: prometheus.exporter.redis

arguments.name: redis_addr
arguments.description: Address (host and port) of the Redis instance to connect to.

arguments.name: check_key_groups_batch_size
arguments.description: Check key or key groups batch size hint for the underlying SCAN.

arguments.name: check_key_groups
arguments.description: List of Lua regular expressions (regex) for grouping keys.

arguments.name: check_keys
arguments.description: List of key-patterns to export value and length/size, searched for with SCAN.

arguments.name: check_single_keys
arguments.description: List of single keys to export value and length/size.

arguments.name: check_single_streams
arguments.description: List of single streams to export info about streams, groups, and consumers.

arguments.name: check_streams
arguments.description: List of stream-patterns to export info about streams, groups, and consumers to search for with SCAN.

arguments.name: config_command
arguments.description: What to use for the CONFIG command.

arguments.name: connection_timeout
arguments.description: Timeout for connection to Redis instance (in Golang duration format).

arguments.name: count_keys
arguments.description: List of individual keys to export counts for.

arguments.name: export_client_list
arguments.description: Whether to scrape Client List specific metrics.

arguments.name: export_client_port
arguments.description: Whether to include the client’s port when exporting the client list.

arguments.name: export_key_values
arguments.description: Whether to export key values as labels when using check_keys or check_single_keys.

arguments.name: incl_system_metrics
arguments.description: Whether to include system metrics. For example redis_total_system_memory_bytes.

arguments.name: is_cluster
arguments.description: Whether the connection is to a Redis cluster.

arguments.name: is_tile38
arguments.description: Whether to scrape Tile38-specific metrics.

arguments.name: max_distinct_key_groups
arguments.description: The maximum number of distinct key groups with the most memory utilization to present as distinct metrics per database.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: Namespace for the metrics.

arguments.name: ping_on_connect
arguments.description: Whether to ping the Redis instance after connecting.

arguments.name: redis_metrics_only
arguments.description: Whether to just export metrics or to also export go runtime metrics.

arguments.name: redis_password_file
arguments.description: Path of a file containing a password.

arguments.name: redis_password_map_file
arguments.description: Path of a JSON file containing a map of Redis URIs to passwords.

arguments.name: redis_password
arguments.description: Password of the Redis instance.

arguments.name: redis_user
arguments.description: User name to use for authentication. Redis ACL for Redis 6.0 and newer.

arguments.name: script_path
arguments.description: Path to Lua Redis script for collecting extra metrics.

arguments.name: script_paths
arguments.description: List of paths to Lua Redis scripts for collecting extra metrics.

arguments.name: set_client_name
arguments.description: Whether to set client name to redis_exporter.

arguments.name: skip_tls_verification
arguments.description: Whether to skip TLS verification.

arguments.name: tls_ca_cert_file
arguments.description: Name of the CA certificate file (including full path) if the server requires TLS client authentication.

arguments.name: tls_client_cert_file
arguments.description: Name of the client certificate file (including full path) if the server requires TLS client authentication.

arguments.name: tls_client_key_file
arguments.description: Name of the client key file (including full path) if the server requires TLS client authentication.
